## Admissions Analysis

## Awesome Fonts 

Font Awesome in Quarto Typst PDF

This requires a different approach.

The Quarto Font Awesome extension supports HTML and LaTeX PDF, but not native Typst PDF. For Typst, use its dedicated Font Awesome package. GitHub

First, install the Font Awesome desktop .otf fonts on your Mac from Font Awesome.

Then add the following to your .qmd document:

```{=typst}

#import "@preview/fontawesome:0.6.2": fa-icon

#fa-icon("graduation-cap", solid: true) Student Admissions

#v(5mm)

#fa-icon("chart-line", solid: true, fill: blue) Admissions Trends

#v(5mm)

#fa-icon("users", solid: true, fill: green) Student Enrolment

```


```{=typst}
#fa-icon(  "chart-line",   solid: true,   fill: blue,  size: 18pt, ) Admissions Trends
```

## Headings and Fonts

```{=typst}

= #fa-icon("graduation-cap", solid: true) Admissions

== #fa-icon("chart-line", solid: true) Trends

== #fa-icon("users", solid: true) Enrolment

```

```{=typst}
#rect(  fill: rgb("#EAF3FF"),  radius: 5pt,  inset: 10pt,)[  #fa-icon("lightbulb", solid: true, fill: blue)  *Key Insight*
  Admissions increased by 12% compared with last year.]

```

```{=typst}
#let highlight(content) = {  text(    fill: blue,    weight: "bold",  )[ #content ]}

#highlight("Admissions increased by 12%")

#highlight("Missing admission dates detected")

#highlight("Enrolment target achieved")

```

```{=typst}
#import "typst_ReportFunctions.typ": *
```

## Admissions Performance

```{=typst}
#insight-box[
  Admissions increased by *12%* compared  with the previous admission year.

  The highest growth was observed at  Amity University Jaipur.
]
```

## Data Quality

```{=typst}
#warning-box[
  Approximately 5% of application records  contain missing admission-stage dates.

  These records require verification.
]

#report-box(  title: "Admissions Conversion",  icon: "chart-line",
  color: purple,  background: rgb("#F3EAFF"),
)[
  The application-to-enrolment conversion  rate increased from *28% to 34%*.
]
```

## Positive Outcomes

```{=typst}
#success-box[
  The university achieved its enrolment  target for the current academic year.
]
```


```{=typst}
#kpi-card(
  title: "Enrolment Rate",
  value: "34.2%",
  change: "+3.4 pp",
  icon: "chart-line",
)
```

```{=typst}
#kpi-card(
  title: "Total Applications",
  value: "25,480",
  change: "+12.5% YoY",
  icon: "users",
  description: "Compared with previous admission year",
)
```

```{=typst}
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
  gutter: 5mm,

  kpi-card(
    title: "Applications",
    value: "25,480",
    change: "+12.5%",
    icon: "users",
    color: rgb("#174EA6"),
  ),

  kpi-card(
    title: "Enrolments",
    value: "8,250",
    change: "+8.2%",
    icon: "graduation-cap",
    color: rgb("#16733D"),
    background: rgb("#E7F5EC"),
  ),

  kpi-card(
    title: "Conversion",
    value: "32.4%",
    change: "+2.1 pp",
    icon: "chart-line",
    color: rgb("#A65E00"),
    background: rgb("#FFF3DF"),
  ),
)
```

```{=typst}
#kpi-row(
  kpi-card(title: "Applications",  change: "+12.5%", value: "25,480"),
  kpi-card(title: "Enrolments", value: "8,250"),
  kpi-card(title: "Conversion", value: "32.4%"),
)
```

```{=typst}
#kpi-card(  title: "Missing Records",  value: "125",  change: "-18.5%",
  icon: "triangle-exclamation",  color: rgb("#16733D"),  background: rgb("#FFF3DF"),
)
```
